              The aim of this course is to provide freshman/sophomore-level students with the conceptual framework, factual knowledge, and analytical skills necessary to deal critically with the rapidly changing science of biology and to understand measurement techniques in the field of biology and applications of biology, including electrical circuits for making amplifiers and measuring human hearing abilities with audiometers.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The aim of this course is to provide freshman/sophomore-level students with the conceptual framework, factual knowledge, and analytical skills necessary to deal critically with the rapidly changing science of biology and to understand measurement techniques in the field of biology and applications of biology. The coursework is done via a series of basic laboratory exercises. Students are required to attend all classes. Students shall inform their instructors of dates they will miss class due to an excused absence prior to the date of that anticipated absence. There are no exams, but students are required to write laboratory reports.
